dataset: District-level Census of India 2011 Primary Census Abstract (reproduced CSV)

source.name: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India — Primary Census Abstract (PCA SD), 2011
source.licenseNote: Historical 2011 administrative boundaries and figures; not current population estimates.
source.provenance: Current JSON records were imported from a third-party CSV mirror of the 2011 PCA. The official Census of India NADA catalogue identifies the corresponding original dataset and downloadable XLSX. The local rows have not yet been reconciled record-by-record against that official XLSX; therefore they remain withheld in the application.
source.displayPolicy: Do not display district demographic rows until every record has been reconciled against the official Census of India PCA SD 2011 primary XLSX and mapped to the correct historical district.
source.verificationNote: The source mirror is not the Census of India itself. The official primary dataset is linked above. National aggregate reconciliation is a quality check only and is not row-level verification.

aggregateReconciliation.note: Aggregate totals reconcile to published Census 2011 national totals, but this does not establish row-level accuracy or current-district matching.
